segments.headline: Why can't AI plug in a cable?

beats.narration: Plugging in a cable is easy for us, but it takes a precise touch, and that is hard for robots.
beats.eleven_text: [curious] Plugging in a cable is easy for us, but it takes a precise touch, and that is hard for robots.

beats.narration: So what happened when one of today's most advanced AI models took control of a real robot and tried it?
beats.eleven_text: [excited] So what happened when one of today's most advanced AI models took control of a real robot and tried it?

beats.narration: Researchers gave the AI direct control of real robot arms and asked it to do everyday tasks.
beats.eleven_text: [excited] Researchers gave the AI direct control of real robot arms and asked it to do everyday tasks.

beats.narration: Picking things up and putting them somewhere else mostly worked.

visual.text: Pick up, put down: mostly worked

beats.eleven_text: [excited] Picking things up and putting them somewhere else mostly worked.

beats.narration: But plugging in the cable failed every single time.

beats.narration: The researchers' verdict: these AI models are competent, but not yet practical for real robots.
